title: MEMERAG: A Multilingual End-to-End Meta-Evaluation Benchmark for Retrieval Augmented Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'faithfulness' and 'relevance' within a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) framework. In this technical context, 'faithfulness' refers to the factual grounding of a model's response in retrieved documents rather than religious faith. There is no component evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
